opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship

amount.raw: A Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000, fully funded including all travel and subsistence, plus a financial incentive of £1,000 to part cover replacement labour cost

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Aimed at young people aged 18-24, open to applicants from the UK with a demonstrable interest in the relevant industry (e.g. dairy, regenerative agriculture).
opportunities.summary: A scholarship to develop young talent (aged 18-24) in the farming industry. Recipients undertake a 30-day study tour (e.g. dairy or regenerative agriculture) staying on farms with Nuffield Scholars, build networks, and attend the Nuffield Conference. Includes Nuffield Farming Associate membership. 2027 applications open in November 2026 and close 31 January 2027.
